method: Registered Railway adapter, GraphQL-query-only guard, read-only local SQLite; config requested with decryptVariables:false. No provider mutation in this diagnostic.
context: After a separately reviewed environmentPatchCommit containing only services.<accepted-parent>.isCreated=true, its retained workflow was Complete and the exact native target instance existed.
identities: Project, parent, environment, instance, workflow and trigger identifiers are intentionally omitted from this fixture.

primarySource.interpretation: ServiceInstance has separate optional source/build/deploy/configFile and variable/mount maps. BuildConfig permits builder and buildEnvironment; DeployConfig distinguishes commands, credentials, regions and replica counts. GraphQL EnvironmentConfig is opaque. Exact defaults above are observed native values, not defaults inferred from the CLI types; runtime and useLegacyStacker are not defined by this CLI parser.

limits: This records one empty target configuration, not a universal server default promise.
No source or deployment existed on the target; production's source/identity/trigger fingerprint was unchanged. This does not compare every unrelated production setting or runtime byte.
No credential, variable name/value, source repository, image, command or raw provider error is included.
Application deployment, binding finalization, volume attachment and package access were not performed or proved by this diagnostic.
